    ### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Apply normalized eight-position recency weights to valid causal BPR losses
    valid = seq.ne(0) & pos.ne(0) & neg.ne(0)
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    count = valid.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    active_rows = count.squeeze(1).gt(0)
    if not bool(active_rows.any()):
        # The training loop skips unsupported batches before calling this function.
        return pos_scores[valid].float().sum()

    # Count later valid targets within each sampled chronological suffix.
    distance = valid.long().flip(1).cumsum(dim=1).flip(1) - valid.long()
    log_weight = -math.log(2.0) * distance.float() / 8.0
    active_log_weight = log_weight[active_rows].masked_fill(
        ~valid[active_rows], -torch.inf
    )
    log_z = torch.logsumexp(active_log_weight, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    weights = torch.zeros_like(log_weight)
    weights[active_rows] = (
        torch.exp(active_log_weight - log_z) * count[active_rows].float()
    )

    # Gather before evaluating BPR so invalid logits do not enter the objective.
    margin = pos_scores[valid].float() - neg_scores[valid].float()
    position_loss = -torch.nn.functional.logsigmoid(margin)
    return (position_loss * weights[valid]).sum() / count.sum()
